explanation: Saru mo ki kara ochiru pictures the best climbers slipping. English has 'even Homer nods', from the Roman poet Horace, who noted that even the great poet sometimes slipped.

claims.text: The Japanese saying 'saru mo ki kara ochiru', 'even monkeys fall from trees', means that even experts make mistakes.
The saying does not mean that pride brings a fall, that you should look before you leap, or that you should start small.
The English saying 'even Homer nods' comes from Horace's Ars Poetica, which says that even good Homer sometimes nods.
